column1: # Fixed paths under /tmp that scripts/check-fixed-tmp-paths.sh accepts (#2271).
# Data, not code. One row per path and file: path <TAB> file <TAB> reason.
# A path also covers everything beneath it (/tmp/cascade covers
# /tmp/cascade/deep.json). A row that matches nothing fails the check.
# Add a row only for a path that cannot collide: one that is never opened, or
# one that a single job owns by design. A path a test reads or writes belongs
# under "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR", not here.
# NOT isolated yet. review-one-pr.sh keeps its working files in /tmp/cascade,
# which pr-review.yml uploads as the run artifact and prompts/cascade-action.md
# names to the model, so a variable in the script alone cannot move it. Every
# test that runs the script shares the directory. It needs its own change.
/tmp/cascade
column3: pr-review working directory; named by pr-review.yml (artifact upload) and prompts/cascade-action.md
